consequence.statement: New optional support for a customized zipkin collector endpoint was added; no operational consequence is stated.

original.statement: Support for a customized zipkin collector endpoint was added.

decision.reason: [ev-9c5e6c5bc8ee] describes only an addition ("Added support customized zipkin collector endpoint"). It says nothing about changed defaults, removals, rejections or required steps. An environment that does nothing does not use the new capability, so "none" (informational) fits. The note does not say outright that the feature is opt-in; that is an inference from the "Added support" wording, so confidence is low.
